mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply conditions, which correlates with improving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the months with a positive month-over-month change in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.5%, it signals a weak labor market and economic distress, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE > 9.5.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the year-over-year change in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2%, it indicates a favorable monetary environment for equities, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing with moderate inflation
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 2%, it indicates a strong economic expansion, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the quarters when GDPC1 yoy growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, it signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the days when FEDFUNDS < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates improving labor market conditions, which correlates with stronger consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the months with a positive month-over-month change in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals a strengthening labor market, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE < 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600 thousand units, it indicates a robust housing market, which correlates with strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of the months when HOUST > 600.
